newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia to invest $8.3 mln in energy in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia to invest $8.3 mln in energy in 1997.

text.p: Mongolia will invest 6.6 billion tugriks ($8.3 million) in the energy sector this year, down from 7.5 billion tugriks last year, the Ministry of Infrastructure Development said on Monday.

One billion tugriks of the total would be used for repairing the capital's Number Three Power Plant and 900 million tugriks for repairs to the capital number four plant, the country's largest, the ministry's statistics department said.
Most of the remaining investment would be spent on connecting rural areas to electricity networks and repairing high voltage lines in provinces.
Mongolia's new government, in power for 10 months, liberalised energy prices in September 1996.
